nodes.description: Public owner address state variable of Ownable; controls privileged functions via onlyOwner.
Mapping (address => mapping(uint => uint)) of locked token balances keyed by beneficiary and unlock timestamp.
IERC20 token contract address holding the locked tokens.
Aggregate amount of tokens tracked as locked in the contract.
Caller-controlled address used for locking, ownership and release targeting.
Miner-influenced current block timestamp returned by getTimestamp_().
Constructor assigning the deploying account as owner.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Internal view returning block.timestamp as current time.
Constructor storing the ERC20 token address in token.
Internal view returning token.balanceOf(this).
Accepts tokens into the timelock via transferFrom and credits balance[_for][_timestamp].
Internal release routine iterating timestamps/values, updating balances and transferring tokens.
External release for the caller itself (msg.sender as beneficiary).
Owner-only forced release for an arbitrary beneficiary address.
Owner-only rescue that can transfer arbitrary ERC20 tokens out of the contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts.
Overflow-safe multiplication helper.
Division helper reverting on division by zero.
Underflow-safe subtraction helper.
Overflow-safe addition helper.
Modulo helper reverting on division by zero.
Production constructor wiring TimeMachineP and SafeERC20Timelock.
External call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, this, _tvalue) executed before balance state updates in accept.
External call token.transfer(_for, _totalValue) performed in release_.
External call IERC20(_token).transfer(_to, _amount) with attacker/owner supplied token address in saveLockedERC20Tokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender of the deployer is read inside the Ownable constructor.
owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner; caller controls the comparison input.
owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner modifier check.
onlyOwner guards execution of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership transfer.
owner storage variable is reassigned to newOwner.
getTimestamp_ returns block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
accept requires _timestamp > getTimestamp_() to validate the lock time.
release_ obtains the current time via getTimestamp_() to validate unlock eligibility.
local _now is assigned the result of getTimestamp_() in release_.
_for parameter of accept is used as beneficiary key and event argument.
_timestamp parameter is required to be greater than the current timestamp and indexes the balance mapping.
_tvalue parameter drives the transferFrom amount in accept.
accept performs the external token.transferFrom call before updating any balance state.
token state variable is the target contract of transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the from address to token.transferFrom.
balance mapping is updated only after the external transferFrom call, enabling reentrant state observation.
accept writes balance[_for][_timestamp] and reads the previous value.
accept calls contractBalance_() before and after the deposit.
contractBalance_ reads token.balanceOf(this).
local _contractBalance holds the pre-deposit contract balance used to compute _value.
local _balance holds the existing locked balance of the beneficiary.
local _totalBalance holds previous totalBalance before accumulation.
local _value is the measured deposited amount credited in accept.
computed _value is added into balance[_for][_timestamp].
_for parameter of release_ is used to look up and transfer locked balances.
_timestamp array parameter is iterated and indexes the balance mapping in release_.
_value array parameter is iterated to determine withdrawal amounts in release_.
release_ reads and decrements balance[_for][_curTimestamp] before transferring.
release_ calls token.transfer after effecting all balance and totalBalance state changes.
token state variable is the target contract of the release transfer.
_for is the destination address of the released tokens.
release_ subtracts the total released value from totalBalance.
release forwards execution to the internal release_ routine.
release passes msg.sender as the beneficiary _for to release_.
releaseForce forwards execution to the internal release_ routine.
onlyOwner guards the privileged releaseForce function.
_for parameter of releaseForce selects an arbitrary beneficiary.
_timestamp array parameter of releaseForce is forwarded to release_.
_value array parameter of releaseForce is forwarded to release_.
onlyOwner guards the token rescue function saveLockedERC20Tokens.
_token parameter defines the arbitrary ERC20 contract used in the rescue call.
_to parameter defines the arbitrary destination of the rescue transfer.
_amount parameter defines the amount transferred out by the rescue.
saveLockedERC20Tokens performs an external call on a caller-supplied token contract.
the arbitrary _token address is cast to IERC20 and used as the external call target.
saveLockedERC20Tokens requires totalBalance <= contractBalance_() after the rescue.
constructor parameter _token is stored into the token state variable.
token state variable is assigned in the SafeERC20Timelock constructor.
SafeERC20TimelockProd constructor invokes the SafeERC20Timelock constructor.
local _len bounds the release loop over the timestamp/value arrays.
local _totalValue accumulates amounts to be transferred and subtracted from totalBalance.
local _curValue holds the locked balance read for the current timestamp.
local _curTimestamp indexes the balance mapping for the current iteration.
local _subValue holds the requested withdrawal amount for the current iteration.
local _now gates the unlock condition _curTimestamp <= _now.
loop index i iterates over the timestamp and value arrays in release_.
accept uses SafeMath.add for balance and totalBalance accumulation, avoiding overflow.
release_ uses SafeMath.sub for balance and totalBalance reductions, avoiding underflow.
SafeERC20TimelockProd inherits TimeMachineP's getTimestamp_ implementation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _for only carries the beneficiary key into accept.
Parameter _timestamp only feeds the unlock-time check and balance key inside accept.
Parameter _tvalue only feeds the transferFrom amount inside accept.
Parameter _for only selects the beneficiary inside the internal release_ routine.
Parameter _timestamp array is only iterated inside the internal release_ routine.
Parameter _value array is only iterated inside the internal release_ routine.
Parameter _for of releaseForce is only forwarded to release_.
Parameter _timestamp of releaseForce is only forwarded to release_.
Parameter _value of releaseForce is only forwarded to release_.
Parameter _token of saveLockedERC20Tokens directly becomes the target of the arbitrary external transfer call.
Parameter _to of saveLockedERC20Tokens directly becomes the destination of the arbitrary external transfer call.
Parameter _amount of saveLockedERC20Tokens directly becomes the value of the arbitrary external transfer call.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership is only used to reassign owner.
Constructor parameter _token is only used to set the token state variable.
Local snapshot of contract balance only supports the deposit accounting in accept.
Local cached beneficiary balance only supports the deposit accounting in accept.
Local cached totalBalance only supports the deposit accounting in accept.
Local _value is the measured deposit credited to the balance mapping in accept.
Local _len is only the loop bound inside release_.
Local _totalValue is only the withdrawal accumulator inside release_.
Local _curValue is only a per-iteration balance read inside release_.
Local _curTimestamp is only a per-iteration mapping key inside release_.
Local _subValue is only a per-iteration withdrawal amount inside release_.
Local _now is only the cached current timestamp used for the unlock check inside release_.
Local loop index i only drives iteration inside release_.
